resources.string: Local by design. No account, no server, no tracking.
Private DNS is on — encrypted queries can bypass the filter. Turn it off to protect every app.
Keeps search results clean across Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and YouTube.
Blocks encrypted DNS to known public resolvers. Restart protection after changing.
Routes all IPv4 traffic through the filter to stop DoH by name and port. Uses more battery. Restart protection after changing.
Blocks UDP/443 for every destination. DoQ on UDP/853 is always blocked. May slow some sites. Restart protection after changing.
Three quick system steps so protection starts automatically and stays on.
Open system settings, choose Apps, then BlockerMod, then Allow restricted settings. Without it the system refuses to start protection on its own after a reboot.
The app is installed outside the store, so Play Protect may ask to confirm. Choose Install anyway when it appears.
If the system forces private DNS, encrypted queries leave the tunnel and the filter cannot see them. Turn private DNS off so protection applies to every application.
